howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能查询 golden_man 内置的手册页:给出 git log、git diff、curl 的命令语法、常用选项、示例,以及相关的 SEE ALSO 命令。共 3 个手册页、3 个选项、3 个示例。
howto.when: 当用户询问 golden_man 相关命令行工具的语法、选项、示例等,或要求测试 man golden build 时触发。

say.text: 查一下 git log 有哪些常用选项
say.note: 会从 git 手册页中提取选项说明。

say.text: git diff 的语法是什么?给个例子
say.note: 会给出 git-diff 的用法和示例。

say.text: curl 怎么静默抓取网页?
say.note: 会返回 curl 的 -s/--silent 说明。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query the built-in man pages for golden_man: it provides command syntax, common options, examples, and SEE ALSO references for git log, git diff, and curl. The index covers 3 man pages, 3 options and 3 examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about golden_man command-line tool syntax, options, examples, or related commands, or wants to test the man golden build.

say_en.text: What are common options for git log?
say_en.note: Pulls option details from the git man page.

say_en.text: Show the syntax for git diff with an example.
How can curl fetch a page silently?
